name: Feddasyr
description: Feddasyr was a planet located in the Elus sector of the Inner Rim. The planet was known for being a drug and gambling hub. During the Galactic Civil War, the planet had a neutral status.
lead_paragraphs: Feddasyr was a planet located in the Elus sector of the Inner Rim. The planet was known for being a drug and gambling hub. During the Galactic Civil War, the planet had a neutral status.
Rebel Agent Sarin operated undercover for 5 years on Feddasyr without her cover ever being blown.
